mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 850K units, indicating robust demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST surpasses 850K.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When unemployment (UNRATE) drops below 6.0% and remains low for 2 consecutive months, signaling a tight labor market, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 60 trading days due to impending wage inflation.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of instances when UNRATE is below 6.0% for 2 months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with a rise in GDP (GDPC1) indicates strong economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, but only if both indicators move in tandem.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.05 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in retail sales (RSAFS) by more than 2% in a single month, indicating reduced consumer spending, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in > 40% of instances when RSAFS declines by more than 2%.

mechanism_narrative: Whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) exceeds the CPI inflation rate (CPIAUCSL), signaling a tightening monetary policy, S&P 500 forward returns tend to be negative over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.02 over any 18-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An unexpected increase in payroll employment (PAYEMS) by more than 200K jobs in a single month, indicating a strong labor market, boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 5d returns in > 55% of instances when PAYEMS surges by more than 200K jobs.

mechanism_narrative: A steady rise in GDP (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters, coupled with low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5%), indicates sustained economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC for the joint signal remains below 0.04 over any 2-year rolling window.
